record.chaining: per-record: 25 GB per video x unlimited videos per free account. 20 TiB = ~820 uploads, no new accounts needed.
record.limits_note: 25 GB and 300 minutes per video; 5 simultaneous uploads; formats limited to video containers (MP4/AVI/MOV/WebM/HEVC/ProRes...); re-encode on ingest
record.reliability_note: Ingest re-encodes, so this only stores video, not arbitrary bytes; official API client is abandoned, retrieval depends on yt-dlp staying current.
